title: Add: discontinue catalog items
prompt: Catalog items can be discontinued. Add an IsDiscontinued flag (default false), hide discontinued items from the item lists, and add `PUT /api/catalog/items/{id}/discontinue`.
done: CatalogItem has IsDiscontinued (default false), the item list endpoints leave discontinued items out, and PUT /api/catalog/items/{id}/discontinue marks an item discontinued

expect.text: The Domain designer's CatalogItem has IsDiscontinued (bool, default false).
The Services designer has the discontinue operation: PUT /api/catalog/items/{id}/discontinue on the catalog API, with the id from the route.
The discontinue operation has an update interaction (an update entity action) on CatalogItem.
